messages:
sol: Quick design sync: trying an accordion approach for eval runs instead of full cards. Goal: reduce vertical noise when you have 200+ tests. Main asks: keyboard focus model, SR semantics, and how approvals show provenance.

tara: Accordion seems promising. Each test row can be a single <button aria-expanded> that toggles a nested region. Important: nested region should have role=region and aria-labelledby pointing to the button. Keeps reading order linear for screenreaders.

ben: Agree. Also want a super-compact row variant for power users (dense rows with inline mini-visuals). Toggle via a view switch in the header. Keep default to accessible-expanded rows for discoverability.

xiang: Mini-visuals: please avoid tiny color-only badges. Add a two-letter status label (OK/FL, or ✔/✖) and a visible numeric score. Color is secondary.

rachael: Copy nit for approval CTA: "Approve run" vs "Mark as approved". Prefer "Approve selected" for bulk flows and single-row: "Approve". Keep primary action consistent across modals.

sol: Good call. UX for bulk approve: select rows -> click approve -> open confirmation sheet that lists "Selected items (n)" and shows provenance lines for each item. We must show original author, last-run-id, and any prior approver comments.

tara: Technical/accessibility: confirmation sheet must trap focus and be dismissible via Esc. Include an aria-describedby that points to a short summary text: "Approving will mark items as reviewed; this action is auditable."

ben: On performance: rendering full provenance for 200 items in the modal is heavy. Suggest modal shows a condensed list with ability to expand any item inline. Also lazy-load provenance details when user expands.

xiang: Small dev note: when expanding inline provenance, ensure server returns minimal object shape: {id, approvers[], notes[]} — but for the UI we'll only show strings and dates. (Dev team please ensure pagination on provenance).

rachael: Accessibility: add an aria-live="polite" region in the modal for status updates (e.g., "Loaded 20 of 120 provenance entries").

deploy-bot: deploy: builds/ui-components/accordion-v2 deployed to staging at 2024-11-02T09:12:00Z

sol: Thanks bot. Interaction detail: keyboard navigation inside accordion: Up/Down to move between headers; Right arrow to expand, Left arrow to collapse (WAI-ARIA recommended). Also Home/End to jump. Make sure tab sequence enters expanded region after Enter/Space expands.

tara: Motion preferences: if we use height animation for expand/collapse, respect prefers-reduced-motion and fall back to instant show/hide. Also provide reduced-motion variant in the token highlight animation.

ben: Diff rendering: current diff injects <ins>/<del> which reflows lines. Proposal: render diffs as inline overlays using position: relative + absolutely positioned highlight spans so layout doesn't shift. Quick CSS: 

```
.diff-token { position: relative; }
.diff-token::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,245,0,0.18), transparent); pointer-events: none; }
```

plus ensure each token has tabindex=0 so keyboard users can focus and SR reads the change type.

xiang: Also make sure diff summary is available at top of expanded region: "3 additions, 1 removal" rather than forcing users to parse token highlights.

rachael: Microcopy: add a tiny help tooltip on the approve button: "Approving will record reviewer and timestamp. Use bulk approve for many similar pass cases." Tooltip should be accessible (aria-describedby + visible on keyboard focus).

sol: Design decision: default view = accordion collapsed, show filter chips (model, run-date, status) at top. Chips must be keyboard-focusable and show clear state. Add keyboard shortcuts: "f" to focus filter bar, "a" + Enter to toggle select-all (announce via aria-live).

tara: One more a11y point: for screenreader users, when filters change, set focus to results count and update it: "Showing 42 results" announced via aria-live=polite.

sol: OK plotting next steps: implement accordion v2 on staging, add condensed row toggle, build bulk-approve modal with lazy provenance, update Figma and handoff tokens. I'll tag Engineering + Design once PR demo is ready. React with :thumbsup: to proceed or :eyes: if you want a follow-up session.
